title: Meet the Staff
seo_title: Meet the Quest Watersports Team | Ottawa, IL
seo_description: Meet the boaters, mechanics and sales pros at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL. Our team helps you enjoy the Illinois River, kayaks, boats and eBikes.
body_html:
The people behind Quest Watersports are boaters, builders, fixers, sales pros and customer-first problem solvers, all working together to make life on the water easier and more fun.

The Quest team

Jeff

Owner

Jeff has been living and breathing the water since founding Quest Watersports in 2008. He launched the region's first membership boat club in 2011 and has spent years building Quest into a destination for marine sales, boat club membership, paddlesports, eBikes and more. He knows customers by name, welcomes people with a smile and is always thinking about what Quest can become next.

Specialties: Marine Sales, Boat Club, Operations. jeff@questwatersports.com

Scott

Mechanic & Shop Manager

Scott has spent 25 years as a marine mechanic, and there is not much he has not seen. From spring tune-ups to winterization and everything in between, he keeps Quest boats running strong through every season. If there is an engine to diagnose or a boat that needs attention, Scott is usually already on it.

Specialties: Marine Mechanics, Winterization, Repairs. scott@questwatersports.com

Chris

Service Coordinator, E-Bike, Sail & Paddle Manager

Chris brings 18 years of experience in sailing and sales with Hobie kayaks and sailboats. Since joining Quest in 2019, he has grown into a leadership role overseeing service coordination, storage and a wide range of specialty products. Friendly, knowledgeable and genuinely helpful, he makes customers feel taken care of right away.

Specialties: Hobie Kayaks, Sailboats, E-Bikes. chris@questwatersports.com

Randi

Marine Sales & Customer Engagement Manager

With over 20 years in sales and customer service, Randi is a major part of the Quest customer experience. She helps customers find the right boat, guides Boat Club members and assists boaters with slips and next steps on the Illinois River. Whether someone is brand new to boating or knows exactly what they want, she makes the process feel approachable and personal.

Specialties: Sales, Customer Service, Marketing. randi@questwatersports.com

John

Detailing & Operations Manager

John has been part of the Quest family for years, working his way up from operations associate to Detailing & Operations Manager. He oversees detailing and helps keep marina operations running smoothly from launch to storage. Do not be surprised if he greets you with a joke and a candy recommendation.

Specialties: Detailing, Marina Operations, Storage. john@questwatersports.com

Eli

Operations Associate

A welcome addition to the Quest crew, Eli jumped in headfirst helping with boat detailing and marina operations. Whether he is moving boats or making them shine, he brings a great attitude to everything he does on the water.

Specialties: Detailing, Marina Operations.

Christian

Operations Associate

Christian joined the Quest team ready to get his hands dirty, and the boats spotless. He helps with detailing and marina operations and is quickly learning what it takes to keep everything moving smoothly.

Specialties: Detailing, Marina Operations.

Come see us on the Illinois River

Stop by the shop, take a demo ride, ask questions or just talk gear. We love helping people find their next adventure on the water. Get in touch or call 815.433.2200.
